bull_case: AI 연산이 데이터센터의 핵심 생산수단으로 이동하고 NVIDIA가 GPU뿐 아니라 CPU·네트워킹·시스템·소프트웨어로 AI factory 표준을 정의하고 있다. Rubin의 생산 출하와 광범위한 주문은 구조적 수요가 단순 GPU 사이클보다 넓음을 시사한다.
bear_case: 현재 성장률은 희소한 AI 인프라 공급과 대규모 hyperscaler capex의 영향을 크게 받는다. 자체 ASIC, 전력·메모리 병목, 수출규제와 투자수익률 둔화가 5~10년 성장률을 정상화시킬 수 있다.
thesis: 구조적 변화와 리더십은 매우 강하다. Q2 FY27 Data Center 매출 $89B(+117% y/y), Rubin의 생산 출하, AI factory 범위가 GPU에서 CPU·네트워킹·소프트웨어로 확대되는 점은 NVIDIA가 단순 수혜자가 아니라 경쟁기준을 바꾸는 쪽임을 지지한다. 다만 현재 수요는 hyperscaler 지출 집중과 전력/공급 제약에 민감하고 자체 ASIC·수출규제는 장기 상한이다.

evidence.claim: Q2 FY27 Data Center revenue was $89.0B, up 117% y/y, while total revenue was $96.2B, up 106% y/y.
NVIDIA's 2026 10-K describes a unified programmable platform spanning hardware, systems, software, algorithms, libraries, models and services, with a growing developer and installed-base ecosystem.
evidence.value: Unified platform across multiple multi-billion-dollar end markets

evidence.claim: NVIDIA stated that Vera Rubin production shipments had begun and purchase orders had been received from every major hyperscaler, AI cloud and system OEM.
The 10-K explicitly notes customers can develop in-house alternatives, while export controls can reduce demand and aid competitors.
evidence.value: Custom silicon and export-control competitive risks

counterevidence: Hyperscaler capex concentration means a spending pause can make structural growth look cyclical.
Customers possess in-house silicon capability and may shift selected workloads to custom accelerators.
Power, memory, packaging and data-center construction constraints can cap realized demand.
Export controls have already reduced addressable China data-center compute demand.
unknowns: AI inference/training spend as a share of global IT capex in FY30-FY35
Long-run mix between merchant accelerators and hyperscaler custom silicon
AI application economics after the current infrastructure buildout

uncertainties.rationale: AI utility is real but the durability of hyperscaler capex growth beyond FY28 is not observable.
Leadership evidence is broad and monetized, though standards can evolve.
Custom silicon, regulation and infrastructure bottlenecks remain meaningful.

falsifiers: Data Center growth falls below 15% for several quarters while customer AI utilization weakens.
Major hyperscalers structurally move a majority of incremental accelerator spend to internal silicon.
NVIDIA platform economics cease improving while competitors match system-level TCO.

key_kpis.name: Rubin/next-gen adoption
key_kpis.threshold: Broad repeat deployments across hyperscalers and enterprises

Rubin deployment scale and customer ROI
FY28 custom-silicon share at top cloud customers

subscores.rationale: AI compute demand is tied to a broad computing-platform transition, not only a short product cycle.
NVIDIA defines system architecture and software standards across the AI factory stack.
Multiple growth axes exist, but custom silicon, export controls and infrastructure constraints are material.
